summary: United Breweries Co Inc (CCU) filed a Form 6-K on May 6, 2026, reporting its consolidated financial and operating results for the first quarter of 2026. The filing is a routine earnings release under Rule 13a-16, providing no mention of any special situation such as acquisitions, divestitures, activist campaigns, or strategic reviews. It discloses a 0.1% EBITDA increase to CLP 131,644 million and a 6.8% decrease in net income to CLP 53,856 million. No deal terms, board recommendations, or advisors are identified. The filing is a standard foreign issuer report of earnings and does not constitute a special-situation event. What to watch: none; this is a routine periodic report.
